description:
About SELENE & ARES

SELENE & ARES is a creative project inspired by the Moon, Mars, and the stories of humanity's journey beyond Earth. We aim to bring forgotten lunar and Martian exploration equipment back into the spotlight through an interactive, visually engaging digital experience.

We are looking for support in:

NASA data research and fact-checking

Web development and interactive mapping

UI/UX design and visual storytelling

Creative ideas for presenting space exploration history
summary:
ASTROGO is an interactive digital space museum designed primarily for middle school students and young learners. It currently features 16 artifacts across the Lunar and Martian Archives, it transforms space archaeology into an engaging journey of exploration and discovery; through exploring the remains on the lunar and martian terrains through this virtual collection.
Our mission is to inspire young generations to look beyond the stars and discover the stories humanity has already left behind. Through ASTROGO, I want children to understand that space exploration isn't just about reaching new worlds; it's about discovering and getting inspired by the past too. We hope to spark curiosity, and inspire tomorrow's explorers to create history without forgetting the past.

AI tools used:
- ChatGPT:Coding assistance and debugging.
- Gamma AI: Presentation template and colour scheme creation.
- Nano Banana:Finding visual resources and generating website images.

Our ASTROGO motive is to, 'Explore, Discover, and Inspire.'
details:
ASTROGO is an interactive digital space museum designed primarily for middle school students. Our mission is to spark curiosity and to inspire young generations to explore not just where humanity is going, but what it has already left behind. Also, we want children to see forgotten space artifacts as 'historical time capsules' rather than mere forgotten machines!

What makes ASTROGO truly special is the perspective behind it: My bestfriend and I, two young, curious learners creating something for our own generation. My best friend and I independently brought this prototype to life in just one day, by brainstorming, combining our creativity, and determination. We didn't wait to grow up to contribute to science education, we started with what we had— and that's exactly the path I want to inspire my generation to follow.

Tools used: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, GitHub Pages, ChatGPT (coding assistance), Gamma AI (presentation template and colour scheme), and Nano Banana (image resource and image generation).

Our most cherished, and greatest achievement isn't just building a prototype within a day; it's proving that young minds don't have to wait for the future to start shaping it.

Signing off,

Team Selene & Ares.
